title: System Security Engineer (SSE)
description: Engineer system protections throughout the lifecycle, connecting security requirements with implementation and validation.
roleDefinition: Contributes to the design, development, and delivery of mission-capable systems and supporting systems-of-systems (such as development, operational, or maintenance systems) so that they are protected against intentional subversion or forced failure. This includes ensuring stakeholder cybersecurity, survivability, and resiliency needs are addressed across the entire system lifecycle; and that there is necessary assurance in the system’s ability to operate in evolving mission and threat environments.
